SELECT T1.PTL_ID, T1.SUB_CODE, T1.SUB_NAME, T1.SUB_CLASS, T1.ASSET_SOURCE, T1.FINPROD_ID, nvl(T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,T3.ASSET_CODE) as FINPROD_MARKET_ID, nvl(T2.FINPROD_ABBR,T3.ASSET_NAME) as FINPROD_ABBR, T2.TRADE_MARKET, T1.MARKET_ID tblMarketId FROM RSK_VALTBL_PRT_BOTASSET_MAP T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID left join RSK_ASSET_INFO T3 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.ASSET_CODE and T3.status in ('E', 'M')
where not exists ( select t2.sub_code from RSK_VALTBL_PRT_BOTASSET_MAP T2 join RSK_VALTBL_SUBRELATION T3 ON T2.SUB_CODE LIKE concat(T3.int_subject,'%') where T1.PTL_ID = T2.PTL_ID and T1.SUB_CODE = T2.SUB_CODE )
and T1.PTL_ID = #{ptlId}
and T1.FINPROD_ID is not null
and T1.FINPROD_ID is null
order by T1.SUB_CODE

SELECT PTL_ID, SUB_CODE, FINPROD_ID FROM RSK_VALTBL_PRT_BOTASSET_MAP
AND PTL_ID = #{ptlId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE2, FINPROD_ABBR, FINPROD_MARKET_ID, TRADE_MARKET FROM FIN_PRODUCT where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT OBJECT_ID, SECNAME FINPROD_ABBR, SECID FINPROD_MARKET_ID, MARKET TRADE_MARKET FROM INTERF_PAYHSRCSECINFO where SECID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT count( 1 ) FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB where PTL_ID = #{ptlId} and SUB_CODE = #{subCode} and FINPROD_ID is null
mapper.update: update RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB set FINPROD_ID = null where PTL_ID = #{ptlId} and (SUB_CODE = #{subCode} OR SUB_NAME in (SELECT SUB_NAME FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB WHERE SUB_CODE = #{subCode} AND PTL_ID = #{ptlId}))

SELECT REP_FINPROD_ID id, REP_FINPROD_NAME text,
concat('01,',FINPROD_MARKET_ID) object FROM REP_ASSET_DEPT WHERE REP_ASSET_TYPE IN('1107','1108','1901','1902')
and (REP_FINPROD_ID LIKE concat(concat('%',#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') or REP_FINPROD_NAME LIKE concat(concat('%',#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
and left(create_dept,6) = #{orgCode}

SELECT T1.PTL_ID, T1.SUB_CODE, T1.SUB_NAME, T1.SUB_CLASS, T1.ASSET_SOURCE, T1.FINPROD_ID, T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T2.FINPROD_ABBR, T2.TRADE_MARKET FROM RSK_VALTBL_PRT_BOTASSET_MAP T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID
where not exists ( select r2.sub_code from RSK_VALTBL_PRT_BOTASSET_MAP r2 join RSK_VALTBL_SUBRELATION r3 ON r2.SUB_CODE LIKE concat(r3.int_subject,'%') where T1.PTL_ID = r2.PTL_ID and T1.SUB_CODE = r2.SUB_CODE )
AND T1.FINPROD_ID is null
and T1.PTL_ID = #{ptlId}
UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT T1.PTL_ID, T1.SUB_CLASS SUB_CODE, T3.ITEM_VALUE SUB_NAME, '' SUB_CLASS, '' ASSET_SOURCE, '' FINPROD_ID, '' FINPROD_MARKET_ID, '' FINPROD_ABBR, '' TRADE_MARKET FROM RSK_VALTBL_PRT_BOTASSET_MAP T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST T3 ON T3.DICT_CODE='ASSET_SUBJECT_SORT' AND T3.ITEM_CODE = T1.SUB_CLASS
where not exists ( select r2.sub_code from RSK_VALTBL_PRT_BOTASSET_MAP r2 join RSK_VALTBL_SUBRELATION r3 ON r2.SUB_CODE LIKE concat(r3.int_subject,'%') where T1.PTL_ID = r2.PTL_ID and T1.SUB_CODE = r2.SUB_CODE )
and T1.FINPROD_ID is null
and T1.PTL_ID = #{ptlId}
mapper.update: update RSK_VALTBL_PRT_BOTASSET_MAP set FINPROD_ID = null where PTL_ID = #{ptlId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and (SUB_CODE = #{subCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: select distinct INT_SUBJECT from COST_INT_MAP_CONFIG where COST_SUBJECT=#{costSubject} union select distinct INT_SUBJECT from RSK_VALTBL_SUBRELATION where COST_SUBJECT=#{costSubject}

SELECT distinct fp.FINPROD_ID id, fp.FINPROD_NAME text , concat('01,',fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID) object FROM FIN_PRODUCT fp
left join data_auth_notify_inst inst on fp.FINPROD_ID = inst.business_id AND inst.model_type = '02'
(fp.FINPROD_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR fp.FINPROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')))
AND fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2}
and (fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F01','F06','F10','F32') OR (FINPROD_TYPE2 NOT IN ('F01','F06','F10','F32') AND inst.institution_code =#{orgCode}))
union all SELECT ASSET_CODE id, nvl(ASSET_NAME,ASSET_CODE) text, concat('01,',ASSET_CODE) object FROM RSK_ASSET_INFO /**资产要素表**/ WHERE status in ('E', 'M')
and (ASSET_CODE LIKE concat(concat('%',#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') or ASSET_NAME LIKE concat(concat('%',#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
